text:
Jordan (People Ops): Heads-up — Luca submitted a resignation today. Last day is 2026-04-10. I’ll start the offboard checklist here so we can coordinate access, benefits, and exit interview timing.
Carmen (Benefits): Thanks Jordan. For COBRA: coverage end date is 2026-04-30 (end of month). I’ll DM Luca the enrollment packet and deadlines. @Luca please confirm mailing address for the COBRA packet. :email:
Luca: Confirmed — address is 1128 Redwood Ave, Apt 3, SF CA 94107. Thanks.
Alex G (IT): Noted. I’ll schedule device pickup for the week of 4/13 unless they want to drop at HQ earlier. Also will prepare SSO deprovision plan: remove OAuth tokens, disable Google workspace, revoke device certs.
Jordan (People Ops): Can you add estimated timestamps for each deprovision step? We need to coordinate with SRE for any service tokens.
Alex G (IT): ETA: Google disable on 4/11 09:00 PST, Okta deprovision on 4/11 09:10, laptop wipe initiated 4/13 window, last badge access revoke 4/11 09:00. I’ll post exact audit IDs after ops.
SRE Oncall: Are there any long-lived service accounts or deploy keys tied to Luca? I can check the audit logs.
Jordan (People Ops): Yes — Luca has 1 deploy key for infra-monitoring and an API token for the billing webhook. I’ll add both to the ticket.
Alex G (IT): If you can drop the key names here I’ll revoke. Prefer doing key revocation during off-peak (4/11 evening) and routing through our fallback push.
Jordan (People Ops): Key names: infra-monitoring-deploy-key and billing-webhook-token-72. Carmen, does COBRA paperwork depend on final pay date?
Carmen (Benefits): COBRA timeline anchors to coverage termination (end of month), not payroll. Final paycheck (including PTO payout) will be processed on 4/15 payroll run. I’ll add a note about benefits end to the exit checklist.
Luca: Quick Q — will my 401(k) rollover paperwork be sent automatically or do I need to request?
Carmen (Benefits): We’ll send the 401(k) distribution options within 5 business days of separation. You’ll need to sign the form. I’ll include the instructions in the DM.
Alex G (IT): Posting the revoke commands here for records:
```
# revoke okta
okta users delete-profile --login luca@redwood.com --confirm
# revoke ssh deploy key
gh repo remove-deploy-key infra-monitoring infra-monitoring-deploy-key
# revoke token
vault delete secret/data/tokens/billing-webhook-token-72
```
Jordan (People Ops): Thanks. @IT Ops Bot, please create ticket PO-4789 and include these steps + pickup window.
IT Ops Bot: Ticket PO-4789 created — assigned to Alex G, due 2026-04-13.
SRE Oncall: I’ll run a quick sweep for any other tokens referencing luca@redwood.com and flag here by EOD.
Jordan (People Ops): Exit interview: do we want to schedule during last week (4/6–4/10) or after final day? Prefer before final day so people can speak freely. Thoughts?
Luca: Before final day is fine for me. Morning slots work best.
Carmen (Benefits): I’ll block 4/09 10:00–10:30 for the benefits/COBRA walkthrough and Jordan can take the exit interview slot 4/10 11:00.
Jordan (People Ops): Sounds good. I’ll send calendar invites and the post-exit survey link.
Alex G (IT): One more ask — please confirm whether Luca will transfer any personal repos or ownership of GCP projects. If not, I’ll set up transfer/archival.
Luca: I have one personal experiment repo (luca/sync-demo) — I’ll mark it public and transfer ownership this week. No GCP projects.
Jordan (People Ops): Great. Last checklist items: badge return, laptop asset tag, archive Slack DMs per policy, and confirm final expense reimbursement by 4/15. I’ll update PO-4789 and ping when tasks are done. :white_check_mark:
